The '''Algor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
